message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jq && git show 7d64381 --stat && echo "=====" && git show 7d64381 | head -150` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: Neither fix is applied. So the vulnerability is the one fixed by `7d64381 Fix overflow on numeric comparison (#2849)`. Let me look at that fix:

commit 7d643810163a944f8fec5c891b9053c12069b509
Author: itchyny <itchyny@cybozu.co.jp>
Date:   Thu Aug 17 15:56:57 2023 +0900

    Fix overflow on numeric comparison (#2849)

    Although #2839 fixed the overflow of exponent subtraction,
    there still is possibility of overflow in the `D2U` macro.
    This patch fixes the overflow in the `D2U` macro, and also
    truncates the maximum digits to `DEC_MAX_DIGITS`.

 src/jv.c      | 4 +++-
 tests/jq.test | 2 +-
 2 files changed, 4 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

commit 7d643810163a944f8fec5c891b9053c12069b509
Author: itchyny <itchyny@cybozu.co.jp>
Date:   Thu Aug 17 15:56:57 2023 +0900

    Fix overflow on numeric comparison (#2849)

    Although #2839 fixed the overflow of exponent subtraction,
    there still is possibility of overflow in the `D2U` macro.
    This patch fixes the overflow in the `D2U` macro, and also
    truncates the maximum digits to `DEC_MAX_DIGITS`.

diff --git a/src/jv.c b/src/jv.c
index b763272..8554169 100644
--- a/src/jv.c
+++ b/src/jv.c
@@ -528,7 +528,9 @@ static decContext* tsd_dec_ctx_get(pthread_key_t *key) {
     if (key == &dec_ctx_key)
     {
       decContextDefault(ctx, DEC_INIT_BASE);
-      ctx->digits = INT32_MAX - (ctx->emax - ctx->emin - 1);
+      // make sure (Int)D2U(rhs->exponent-lhs->exponent) does not overflow
+      ctx->digits = MIN(DEC_MAX_DIGITS,
+          INT32_MAX - (DECDPUN - 1) - (ctx->emax - ctx->emin - 1));
       ctx->traps = 0; /*no errors*/
     }
     else if (key == &dec_ctx_dbl_key)
